itens.trecho: Uma excelente comédia familiar com algumas críticas sociais à mistura. O filme é uma das comédias familiares mais famosas da década de 90, que adapta para o cinema o conto com o mesmo nome de Roald Dahl, onde uma menina, que nasceu numa família idiota e incapaz de a compreender, decide conquistar o direito a ir à escola e a aprender, coisa que os seus pais…

An excellent family comedy with some social criticism in the mix. The film is one of the most famous family comedies of the 1990s, adapting the story of the same name by Roald Dahl for the screen, where a girl, who was born into an idiotic family unable to understand it, decides to win the right to go to school and to learn, which their parents do not…
Hold on to this gem tightly, because movies like Matilda will probably never get made again. Final rating:★★★★ - Very strong appeal. A personal favourite.
